classes.title: Style Class Names

backgroundColor.description: Color used for the background of the Map when the tiles have not yet loaded as the user pans.

clickableIcons.description: Allow map icons (represents a point of interest, also known as a POI) to be clickable.

controlSize.description: Size in pixels of the controls appearing on the map.

draggable.description: The name or url of the cursor to display when mousing over a draggable map. This property uses the css cursor attribute to change the icon. As with the css property, you must specify at least one fallback cursor that is not a URL.

dragging.description: The name or url of the cursor to display when the map is being dragged. This property uses the css cursor attribute to change the icon. As with the css property, you must specify at least one fallback cursor that is not a URL.

disableDefaultUI.description: Enables/disables all default UI buttons. May be overridden individually. Does not disable the keyboard controls, which are separately controlled by the "keyboardShortcuts" option. Does not disable gesture controls, which are separately controlled by the "gestureHandling" option.

controls.description: Enabled/disabled state of the Fullscreen control.

gestureHandling.description: Controls how the map handles gestures.

heading.description: The heading for aerial imagery in degrees measured clockwise from cardinal direction North.

center.description: Initial geographic center of the map

isFractionalZoomEnabled.description: Whether the map should allow fractional zoom levels.

keyboardShortcuts.description: Allow map to be controlled by the keyboard.

enabled.description: If true, enables layer that displays bike lanes and paths and demotes large roads.

suppressInfoWindows.description: Suppress the rendering of info windows when layer features are clicked.

url.description: The URL of the KML document to display.

animation.description: Start an animation. Any ongoing animation will be cancelled. Passing in null will cause any animation to stop.

clickable.description: If true, the marker receives mouse and touch events.

averageCenter.description: Whether the position of a cluster marker should be the average position of all markers in the cluster. If set to false, the cluster marker is positioned at the location of the first marker added to the cluster.

clusterClass.description: The name of the CSS class defining general styles for the cluster markers. Use this class to define CSS styles that are not set up by the code that processes the styles array.

enableRetinaIcons.description: Whether to allow the use of cluster icons that have sizes that are some multiple (typically double) of their actual display size. Icons such as these look better when viewed on high-resolution monitors such as Apple's Retina displays. Note: if this property is true, sprites cannot be used as cluster icons.

gridSize.description: The grid size of a cluster in pixels. The grid is a square.

ignoreHidden.description: Whether to ignore hidden markers in clusters. You may want to set this to true to ensure that hidden markers are not included in the marker count that appears on a cluster marker.

imageExtension.description: The extension name for the cluster icon image files (e.g., "png" or "jpg").

imagePath.description: The full URL of the root name of the group of image files to use for cluster icons. The complete file name is of the form imagePath.imageExtension where n is the image file number (1, 2, etc.).

imageSizes.description: An array of numbers containing the widths of the group of imagePath.imageExtension image files. (The images are assumed to be square.)

maxZoom.description: The maximum zoom level at which clustering is enabled or null if clustering is to be enabled at all zoom levels.

minimumClusterSize.description: The minimum number of markers needed in a cluster before the markers are hidden and a cluster marker appears.

title.description: The tooltip to display when the mouse moves over a cluster marker.

zoomOnClick.description: Whether to zoom the map when a cluster marker is clicked. You may want to set this to false if you have installed a handler for the click event and it deals with zooming on its own.

crossOnDrag.description: If false, disables cross that appears beneath the marker when dragging.

cursor.description: Mouse cursor to show on hover

draggable.description: If true, the marker can be dragged.

enabled.description: Enable/disable rendering of marker layer

anchor.description: The position at which to anchor an image in correspondence to the location of the marker on the map. By default, the anchor is located along the center point of the bottom of the image.

labelOrigin.description: The origin of the label relative to the top-left corner of the icon image, if a label is supplied by the marker. By default, the origin is located in the center point of the image.

origin.description: The position of the image within a sprite, if any. By default, the origin is located at the top left corner of the image (0, 0).

scaledSize.description: The size of the entire image after scaling, if any. Use this property to stretch/shrink an image or a sprite.

size.description: The display size of the sprite or image. When using sprites, you must specify the sprite size. If the size is not provided, it will be set when the image loads.

url.description: The URL of the image or sprite sheet.

path.description: The symbol's path, which is a built-in symbol path, or a custom path expressed using SVG path notation.

rotation.description: The angle by which to rotate the symbol, expressed clockwise in degrees. A symbol in an IconSequence where fixedRotation is false is rotated relative to the angle of the edge on which it lies.

scale.description: The amount by which the symbol is scaled in size. For symbol markers, this defaults to 1; after scaling, the symbol may be of any size.

color.description: The symbol's stroke color. All CSS3 colors are supported except for extended named colors.

enabled.description: Whether to draw stroke along the path. Set it to false to disable borders.

opacity.description: The symbol's stroke opacity. For symbol markers, this defaults to 1.

icons.description: The icons to be rendered along the polyline.

items.description: Describes how icons are to be rendered on a line. If your polyline is geodesic, then the distances specified for both offset and repeat are calculated in meters by default. Setting either offset or repeat to a pixel value will cause the distances to be calculated in pixels on the screen.

fixedRotation.description: If true, each icon in the sequence has the same fixed rotation regardless of the angle of the edge on which it lies. If false, case each icon in the sequence is rotated to align with its edge.

icon.description: The icon to render on the line.

anchor.description: The position of the symbol relative to the polyline. The coordinates of the symbol's path are translated left and up by the anchor's x and y coordinates respectively. The position is expressed in the same coordinate system as the symbol's path.

customPath.description: The symbol's custom path expressed using SVG path notation

color.description: The symbol's fill color. All CSS3 colors are supported except for extended named colors. Defaults to the stroke color of the corresponding polyline.

enabled.description: Whether to fill the path with color. Set it to false to disable filling.

path.description: The symbol's path, which is a built-in symbol path, or a custom path expressed using SVG path notation.

rotation.description: The angle by which to rotate the symbol, expressed clockwise in degrees. A symbol in an IconSequence where fixedRotation is false is rotated relative to the angle of the edge on which it lies.

scale.description: The amount by which the symbol is scaled in size. Defaults to the stroke weight of the polyline; after scaling, the symbol must lie inside a square 22 pixels in size centered at the symbol's anchor.

color.description: The symbol's stroke color. All CSS3 colors are supported except for extended named colors. Defaults to the stroke color of the polyline.

enabled.description: Whether to draw stroke along the path. Set it to false to disable borders.

opacity.description: The symbol's stroke opacity. Defaults to the stroke opacity of the polyline.

offset.description: The distance from the start of the line at which an icon is to be rendered. This distance may be expressed as a percentage of line's length (e.g. '50%') or in pixels (e.g. '50px').

repeat.description: The distance between consecutive icons on the line. This distance may be expressed as a percentage of the line's length (e.g. '50%') or in pixels (e.g. '50px'). To disable repeating of the icon, specify '0'.

points.description: Sets the path for this polyline. The ordered sequence of coordinates of the Polyline. This path may be specified using either a simple array of LatLngs, or an MVCArray of LatLngs. Note that if you pass a simple array, it will be converted to an MVCArray Inserting or removing LatLngs in the MVCArray will automatically update the polyline on the map.

mapId.description: The Map ID of the map.

controlMapTypeIds.description: IDs of map types to show in the control.

controlStyle.description: Style of map type control to display.

controls.description: The initial enabled/disabled state of the map type control.

restriction.description: Defines a boundary that restricts the area of the map accessible to users. When set, a user can only pan and zoom while the camera view stays inside the limits of the boundary.

bounds.description: When set, a user can only pan and zoom inside the given bounds. Bounds can restrict both longitude and latitude, or can restrict latitude only. For latitude-only bounds use west and east longitudes of -180 and 180, respectively, for example, latLngBounds: {north: northLat, south: southLat, west: -180, east: 180}.

strict.description: Bounds can be made more restrictive by setting the strictBounds flag to true. This reduces how far a user can zoom out, ensuring that everything outside of the restricted bounds stays hidden. The default is false, meaning that a user can zoom out until the entire bounded area is in view, possibly including areas outside the bounded area.

tilt.description: Controls the automatic switching behavior for the angle of incidence of the map. The only allowed values are 0 and 45.

max.description: The maximum zoom level which will be displayed on the map.
